en.headline: SAR boccia athletes set up all-Hong Kong women's BC4 final
en.dek: Cheung Yuen and Vivian Lau both advanced on Wednesday morning, guaranteeing Hong Kong gold and silver in the event at the Asian Para Games.
body: Hong Kong, China is guaranteed a gold and a silver medal in the women’s boccia BC4 event at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games after Cheung Yuen and Vivian Lau both reached the final.
Cheung defeated her Malaysian opponent 6-4 in the semi-finals, while Lau beat China’s Lin Ximei 6-1. The two teammates will face each other for the gold medal on Wednesday afternoon.
In the men’s BC1 event, John Loung of Hong Kong, China lost 6-2 to his Singaporean opponent in the semi-finals and will contest the bronze medal match later on Wednesday.

zh.headline: 港隊女子BC4硬地滾球決賽全港對決
zh.dek: 張苑及劉詠嫻周三上午先後晉級，確保港隊在亞殘運會該項目奪得金銀牌。
body: 中國香港隊在愛知-名古屋2026年亞殘運會女子硬地滾球BC4項目確保金銀牌，張苑及劉詠嫻均晉身決賽。
張苑在半決賽以6比4擊敗馬來西亞對手，劉詠嫻則以6比1擊敗中國選手林細妹。兩人將於周三下午對決爭金。
男子BC1項目方面，中國香港的龍子健在半決賽以2比6不敵新加坡對手，將於周三稍後爭奪銅牌。
